title_zh: 宁德时代：电池里的冠军
title_en: Chinese Companies (14/20): CATL, the Battery Champion
note_en: 随着 "along with, as" opens a sentence by naming a change that another change follows: 随着电动汽车市场快速增长，宁德时代的电池订单也迅速增加 "As the electric car market grew rapidly, CATL's battery orders shot up as well." The second half usually contains 也 or a word of change such as 增加 or 提高. Don't use 随着 for a simple point in time; English "as" can mean "when," but 随着 always describes two things developing together.
